approved_prototype.statement: Fix the pyramid $\lambda$, the origin $c=(c_1,\dots,c_l)$ and the truncated tensor space $V_c^{\otimes d}$: as a vector space it is $V^{\otimes d}$, it carries the left action of $U(\mathfrak p)$ twisted by $\eta_c$, $\eta_c(e_{i,j})=e_{i,j}+\delta_{i,j}c_{\mathrm{col}(i)}$, and the right action of the cyclotomic quotient $H_d(\Lambda)$, $\Lambda=\sum_{j}\Lambda_{c_j+q_j-n} on the appropriate integer-coset chains$, defined on the generators by $s_i\mapsto$ place permutation of the $i$-th and $(i+1)$-th factors and $x_1\mapsto (e+\sum_{j=1}^N(c_{\mathrm{col}(j)}+q_{\mathrm{col}(j)}-n)e_{j,j})\otimes1^{\otimes(d-1)}-\sum_{k=2}^d\sum_{\mathrm{col}(i)<\mathrm{col}(j)}e_{i,j}\otimes1^{\otimes(k-2)}\otimes e_{j,i}\otimes1^{\otimes(d-k)}$ and $x_{j+1}\mapsto s_jx_js_j+s_j$; the action is well defined by the cyclotomic-quotient lemma. Restricting the left action from $U(\mathfrak p)$ to $W(\lambda)$ makes $V_c^{\otimes d}$ a filtered $(W(\lambda),H_d(\Lambda))$-bimodule. The associated graded of this bimodule is the Vust tensor space: $\mathrm{gr}\,V_c^{\otimes d}\cong V^{\otimes d}$ with the left $U(\mathfrak g^e)$-action and the right $C_l[x_1,\dots,x_d]\rtimes\mathbb C[S_d]$-action of Vust's theorem, where $\mathrm{gr}\,x_1=e\otimes1^{\otimes(d-1)}$ and $\mathrm{gr}\,s_i$ is the place permutation. The canonical isomorphism $\mu_d\colon\mathbb C_c\circledast V^{\circledast d}\to V_c^{\otimes d}$ of Skryabin's equivalence is an isomorphism of $(W(\lambda),H_d)$-bimodules, and the two actions commute: $W(\lambda)$ and $H_d(\Lambda)$ generate mutual centralizers of the filtered tensor space (proved in the next item).
approved_prototype.strategy: Assume AC and work over C. Restrict the ordinary p tensor action twisted by c to W. The explicit tail/head χ equations from Skryabin's tensor identification give the displayed x_1: the diagonal is c_col+q_col−n, and the negative cross-column correction has the displayed order. Recursion gives the other x_j and matrix-unit expansion gives the affine relations. The raw tensor action commutes with W because its χ equations identify it with the transported universal Casimir action. The cyclotomic supplier proves its exact polynomial, not just its spectrum. With column grading the c and diagonal corrections are lower degree and the cross-column term has degree0; leading x_1=e_1 and leading W=U(g^e). Thus the associated graded tensor action is exactly Vust's. Associativity follows from uniqueness of the Taylor PBW solution. Full details are the finite-W matrix proof §4 and the Casimir suppliers. In this identification the prefix T modes retain their actual displacement index. The loop symbol of T_ij^(r+1) uses the supplier K index r; the finite xi row/box bijection does not alter the physical box labels in x_1.
